name: Original
tagline: The classic Counter-Strike rules: round-based, no mid-round respawn, and money decides your loadout.
summary: Original modes are the classic modes carried over from the original Counter-Strike - the Terrorist versus Counter-Terrorist mission maps. They use non-instantaneous respawn (you return only at the start of the next round) and put more weight on the money a player earns to buy weapons and equipment. The wiki counts four official modes in the Original category and notes a South Korean update on 8 August 2019 that added tournament-rule tweaks and UI improvements.
description: Per the wiki, Original modes are the classic modes in original Counter-Strike. They promote non-instantaneous respawn, meaning players respawn only at the start of the next round, and place more importance on the amount of money a player has to buy weapons and equipment. There are four official modes categorised as Original modes (the digest did not render their names). As of 8 August 2019 in South Korea, Original mode was updated with new features including tournament rule modifications and UI improvements. Faction-exclusive basic weapons apply here (for example AK-47 for Terrorists and M4A1 for Counter-Terrorists).
rules: Round-based; dead players respawn at the start of the next round.
Money earned per round buys weapons and equipment.
Classic mission objectives from Counter-Strike (bomb, hostage and other original scenarios).
Some weapons are faction-exclusive to buy in this mode.
trivia: The wiki main page lists 'Original' as the first game-mode family, alongside Team Deathmatch, Death (match) and Basic Gun (deathmatch) variants.
